goal: Patch prioritisation: which patches go first, by exploitability, exposure and business effect.
use: Patch prioritisation: which patches go first, by exploitability, exposure and business effect. Use when a list of available patches needs an order.

steps.note: List the patches. Each package or system, its version and fix.
Rank by exploitability. Put known-exploited issues first.
Rank by exposure. Internet-facing and privileged systems first.
Estimate effort. Note the restart or downtime each patch needs.
Report. The ordered list with the reason for each place.
